summary: Completed comprehensive testing of MEDILO Healthcare Centralized Pricing Feature. All 7 features working correctly. Backend APIs 100% functional. Frontend UI properly displays MEDILO-controlled prices. Pharmacy cannot modify prices.
passed_tests: 1. Customer can see MEDILO prices on medicine cards - ₹25.00, ₹85.00, ₹50.00 displayed correctly
2. Customer cart shows total calculated from MEDILO prices - ₹110.00 (25+85) calculated correctly
3. Order creation calculates total_amount from medicine master - Backend verified
4. Ops dashboard can add medicines with price field - Price (₹) field with red asterisk (required)
5. Pharmacy inventory confirmation only accepts batch & expiry (NO price input) - Verified in code and UI
6. Invoice shows MEDILO-controlled prices - Unit Price ₹85.00, Total ₹255.00
7. Pharmacy dashboard shows prices as read-only - 'Order Total (MEDILO Price): ₹255.00'
Pharmacy staff login and dashboard access
Customer login and home page access
critical_code_review_comments: MedicineResponse.price and OrderItem.unit_price are Optional with defaults for backward compatibility - good design
InventoryConfirmation model correctly excludes price field - pharmacy cannot override
Invoice generation uses unit_price from order items (set during order creation from medicine master)
Frontend Cart.js correctly calculates total from item.price * item.quantity
Pharmacy Dashboard shows 'MEDILO Price' label and 'Prices are controlled by MEDILO' notice
